Ask HN: Why can AI prove Riemann but not solve cust svc problems?
items.summary: I’m genuinely curious on perspectives here. My hunch is some of the answers might imply the existential risk to humanity is not quite what it seems. My hypothesis is that you need both verifiability and a domain-native semantic model/self-contained symbolic universe. Those conditions don’t hold for a lot of human activity. I think the corollary to this hypothesis is whether semantic model construction itself is verifiable, in which many more domains will start to look like coding and math.

items.summary: It's common to consult an AI via your cell phone for just about everything. Every little question. A little authority that lives in your pocket and answers all your questions and tells you what's right and wrong and what's true and false. That makes an excellent form of mind control. And when everybody is doing it then the whole population is mind controlled. This is happening right now. What do you think about that?
